# Multi-Source Evidence Dossier: slalom.com

=== SECTION: FIRST_PARTY_PRACTICE (URI: https://www.slalom.com/services/cloud-data) ===
Slalom delivers modern cloud data architecture, systems integration, and migration services. Headquarters: Seattle, WA, with 45 offices across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. We specialize in Fortune 500 financial services and healthcare clients.

=== SECTION: VENDOR_REGISTRY (URI: https://snowflake.com/partners/services/slalom) ===
Slalom is an audited Snowflake Elite Services Partner with over 150 SnowPro Core and Advanced certified architects. Validated in Financial Services and Healthcare specializations.

=== SECTION: FIRST_PARTY_CASE_STUDY (URI: https://www.slalom.com/case-studies/fintech-streaming) ===
Case Study: Modernizing a global fintech payment platform with Snowflake and Apache Kafka. Cut query latency by 80% and reduced monthly infrastructure spend by $1.2M with zero cutover downtime.

=== SECTION: ATS_REQUISITIONS (URI: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/slalom/lead-cloud-architect) ===
Hiring 12 Enterprise Solutions Architects to lead turnkey cloud data modernization and streaming deployments for our enterprise clients.
